subject: EchoMed: additional teams onboarding — API keys, capacity & term revision
messages:
From: Mei Chen <mei.chen@echomed.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@echomed.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EchoMed API expansion — inventory and timing

Hi Tessa / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We had an internal product planning session and want to expand the integration to three additional teams (Clinical QA, Triage UI, and Billing Reconciliation). Attached is a quick inventory (CSV) that shows the teams, expected monthly request volume, and primary contacts. High level asks:

- New API keys scoped per project (separate keys to enforce quotas)
- Staggered rollout across teams over Q4 (Clinical QA first)
- Request confirmation of any term changes or minimums — we heard there might be a threshold for reserved capacity?

Can you confirm rough timelines and whether we should expect any pricing/term adjustments for adding these projects under the same account? We have a procurement window the week of Oct 4.

Thanks,
Mei Chen\Product Manager — Integrations\EchoMed Systems
Attachments: EchoMed_MAAP_inventory.csv (CSV, 12 rows)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Mei Chen <mei.chen@echomed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EchoMed API expansion — inventory and timing

Hi Mei — really helpful inventory, thanks. Quick read and notes below. Long answer: yes, we can support per-project keys and a staggered rollout; depending on cumulative committed throughput there are a couple of path options on terms. Short answer on timing: we can produce the updated SOW + order form within 3 business days and have API keys ready for the first pilot by Sept 29 if we lock scope this week.

Notes from our side:
- Recommended approach: issue three scoped API keys (one per team) + a sandbox key for QA.
- If EchoMed wants to reserve burst/dedicated capacity for Clinical QA (low latency SLA), we should add a small dedicated pool — that impacts monthly committed spend.
- Otherwise, hosted usage billing plus a small token-tier adjustment will cover the increased volume.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal alignment call (30 min) — propose Fri 9/17 11am PT or Mon 9/20 10am PT.
2) We’ll send a draft SOW v3 and an order form showing two pricing scenarios (hosted vs reserved capacity).
3) You confirm which teams pilot first and we provision the sandbox keys.

I’m copying Ben (accounts) and Laura (CS/ops) to size capacity and prepare a draft SOW.

Best,
Tessa Morgan\Account Executive, Redwood Inference\Phone: (415) 555-0132

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Mei Chen <mei.chen@echomed.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EchoMed API expansion — inventory and timing

Adding capacity details from infra/ops after quick read of the CSV.

Ben: summary
- Clinical QA (pilot): estimated 4M tokens/month; 99th pct latency target 120ms — recommend reserved pod with small burst reserve (1 x L-GPU unit) if low-latency is critical.
- Triage UI: 8M tokens/month steady-state — fits hosted but benefits from prefix caching and a dedicated cache layer.
- Billing Reconciliation: 2M tokens/month — hosted fine, consider higher cache TTL to reduce cost.

Deployment cadence suggestion (minimize churn):
Week 1 (pilot): Clinical QA sandbox + pilot keys
Week 3: Clinical QA production key + monitoring hooks
Week 5: Triage UI sandbox
Week 7: Triage UI production
Week 9: Billing sandbox + production by Week 11

I’ll attach a simple template for key naming and rate limit defaults (CSV). Also flagging that reserved capacity commit changes the order form; Laura — can you prepare two line items for the SOW?

— Ben
Attachment: redwood-api-key-template.csv (key_name, project, default_qps)

From: Mei Chen <mei.chen@echomed.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Ortiz <d.ortiz@echomed.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EchoMed API expansion — inventory and timing

Thanks Tessa / Ben — that cadence looks good and aligns with our Q4 plans. A few clarifications from procurement:

- EchoMed prefers to avoid a large fixed reserved commit up front. Is there a small reserved option for only Clinical QA for the first 90 days?
- For the order form, procurement needs a single consolidated line item for all three projects, and an addendum for the reserved pod if we select it during the pilot.
- For keys: we need the keys segmented by project and also an internal tag so our SRE can rotate without touching other projects (key naming template looks fine).

We’ll sign the SOW contingent on two items: (1) ability to add the reserved pod later by amendment without redoing the whole contract, and (2) a DocuSign link or order form that shows the hosted pricing and a separate reserved-pod addendum.

I can confirm pilot start on Sept 29 if we receive the sandbox keys and SOW by next Tues (9/21).

Best,
Mei

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Mei Chen <mei.chen@echomed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EchoMed API expansion — inventory and timing

Mei — great, thanks for the clear asks. Confirming action items and timelines: 

- We will deliver: draft SOW v3 and consolidated order form showing hosted pricing + a reserved-pod addendum by Tue 9/21 EOD. (Laura to own line items & order form).
- Sandbox keys: redwood-sandbox-echomed-clinicalqa, redwood-sandbox-echomed-triageui, redwood-sandbox-echomed-billing — provisioning scheduled for Tue 9/21 morning. (Monica to provision keys and provide rotation instructions).
- Contract flexibility: we will include amendment language that allows adding a reserved pod within the first 90 days without re-signing the master SOW — will be explicitly called out in the addendum.
- DocuSign: I’ll push the order form to DocuSign for signature once Laura confirms the numbers; HubSpot deal updated: EM-2026-047.

Attachments: EchoMed_SOW_v3_draft.pdf (draft with both pricing scenarios)
DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/EM-2026-047

Can we lock a 30-min technical handoff for Tue 9/21 9am PT for provisioning and key rotation steps? If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and the sandbox key CSV.

Thanks — Tessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
